name: GSE137293_scar_vs_border
comparison: Scar (infarct core) vs Border zone (peri-infarct), 4wk post-I/R
description: Pig I/R model: P30 pigs, 60min LAD occlusion + 4wk reperfusion. Scar vs Border zone comparison — CAVEAT: no sham control; comparison captures injury severity gradient, not disease vs healthy. DEG: scipy Welch t-test on log2(CPM+1), P<0.05, |log2FC|>0.3. Pig→human: direct gene symbol matching + homologene (inTax=9823). Dropped 23 ENSSCG genes without clear ortholog.
_note: Scar vs border — use with caution; not a MIRI-vs-sham comparison.
